name: Container
description: Full-width flex container that lays out content horizontally with wrapping or vertically.

semantics.nativeAttributes: Forward the target stack's native div attributes and events.
semantics.content: Render children inside the flex container.

props.name: direction
props.description: Controls the flex direction and wrapping behavior.

accessibility: Keep the default div semantics unless the target application requires a more specific semantic grouping.
Preserve the accessible semantics of all child content.
Forward native attributes and custom classes according to the target framework.
adaptationRules: Implement Container as a reusable component in the target application's framework.
Map direction to the target styling system without changing horizontal wrapping or vertical stacking behavior.
Use the target framework's native children or slot/content convention.
Do not install Preact, Sass or any other dependency solely for this component.
